normalization_policy.original_text: Preserved verbatim for both reference and ASR output
normalization_policy.strict_CER: Unicode character Levenshtein after removing Unicode punctuation and whitespace only; retain letter case, digits, symbols, filler words, homophones and lexical errors
normalization_policy.traditional_to_simplified_CER: Separate metric using official OpenCC1.1.9 TSPhrases longest match, then TSCharacters first target, followed by the same punctuation/space removal; this is a dictionary implementation, not the OpenCC compiled library
forbidden_corrections: prompt injection into recognizer to force reference

limitations: Small convenience sample, not a representative Chinese WER/CER benchmark and cannot prove universal accuracy
Official example references are supplied by the source project; they are not outputs generated by our evaluated recognizer
Training-set membership of these public examples is unknown. Shared baseline means shared across tested models, not held out from pretraining
The 14.749-second sample is Chinese-English mixed; aggregate separately from pure Chinese
No synthesized speech, private recording, cloud transcription, gain change or resampling; original zh-short is an existing lossless frame crop
